source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 30 exercise hal (PDF 214-216): MCQs wajah ke saath, short, constructed aur descriptive jawab, spectra ka bayan, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 30 (NMR Spectroscopy) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain. Spectrum wale sawalon mein tasveer ki jagah us ka bayan likha gaya hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I. NMR relies on the magnetic properties of nuclei known as:
(NMR nuclei ki kis magnetic khasiyat par mabni hai?)
blocks.explanation: NMR nuclei (maslan ¹H, ¹³C) ki magnetic khasiyat, yani nuclear spin, par mabni hai; yeh nuclei chhote magnets ki tarah kaam karte hain (30.1).

blocks.prompt:
II. Chemical shift (δ) in the ¹H NMR spectroscopy is measured relative to TMS and is expressed in:
(¹H NMR mein chemical shift (δ) TMS ke muqable mein kis unit mein likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chemical shift TMS peak (0.0 ppm) ke muqable mein peak ki jagah hai aur parts per million (ppm) mein naapa jata hai (30.3).

blocks.prompt:
III. Deuterated solvents (CDCl₃) are used in ¹H NMR to:
(¹H NMR mein deuterated solvents (CDCl₃) kyun istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aam solvents mein H atoms hote hain jin ke tez signals sample ki peaks chhupa dete. Deuterium ko alag radio frequency chahiye, is liye CDCl₃ ki ¹H peak nahi aati aur solvent "khamosh" rehta hai (30.2). Reference TMS hai, solvent nahi.

blocks.prompt:
IV. The primary purpose of measuring the peak area in ¹H NMR is to find the:
(¹H NMR mein peak area naapne ka asal maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har peak ke neeche ka area us peak wale protons ki tadaad ke mutabiq hota hai, maslan ethanol ke OH, CH₂, CH₃ ke liye 1 : 2 : 3 (30.4.1). Padosi protons splitting se pata chalte hain, area se nahi.

blocks.prompt:
V. Splitting is typically not observed for O-H or N-H protons because of:
(O-H ya N-H protons ki splitting aam tor par kyun nahi hoti?)
blocks.explanation: O ya N par lage H atoms molecules ke darmiyan tezi se adla badli (exchange) hote rehte hain, is liye yeh bina splitting singlet dete hain aur in ka δ wasee range mein hota hai (30.4.3).

blocks.prompt:
VI. In the n+1 splitting rule, 'n' represents the number of protons on:
(n+1 rule mein 'n' kin protons ki tadaad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Signal n + 1 sub-peaks mein toot-ta hai, jahan n saath wale (adjacent) carbon atom(s) par protons ki tadaad hai (30.4.2).

blocks.prompt:
VII. The chemical shift (δ) of a ¹³C peak identifies the:
(¹³C peak ka chemical shift (δ) kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: ¹³C peak ki jagah (δ) batati hai ke carbon alkane, alkene, aromatic ring, O ya halogen ke saath, ya C=O mein hai (Table 30.3).

blocks.prompt:
VIII. The number of peaks in a ¹³C NMR spectrum equals the number of:
(¹³C NMR spectrum mein peaks ki tadaad kis ke barabar hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har peak aik alag carbon environment ki hai; barabar (equivalent) carbons aik peak dete hain (30.7.2). ¹²C NMR inactive hai.

blocks.prompt:
IX. How many ¹³C peaks does propane (CH₃CH₂CH₃) show?
(Propane (CH₃CH₂CH₃) kitni ¹³C peaks deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono kinaron ke CH₃ carbons barabar hain aur darmiyani CH₂ alag: 2 environments, 2 peaks (30.7.2).

blocks.prompt:
X. What is the splitting pattern for a proton with 2 neighbouring protons (n=2)?
(2 padosi protons (n=2) wale proton ki splitting kaisi hogi?)
blocks.explanation: n + 1 = 2 + 1 = 3 sub-peaks, yani triplet (Table 30.2), jaise ethanol ka CH₃ signal.

blocks.prompt:
a) State two reasons why TMS is a standard for ¹H NMR.
TMS ¹H NMR ka standard kyun hai? Do wajahen.
blocks.explanation:
1. TMS, Si(CH₃)₄, ke tamam 12 protons barabar (equivalent) hain, is liye aik tez peak deta hai (0.0 ppm).
2. Is ki peak bilkul daayen kinare par aati hai (Si ki kam electronegativity), aksar organic signals se door. Yeh inert aur volatile (jaldi urne wala) bhi hai, is liye aasani se nikal jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
b) Why does deuterium (D) not appear in a ¹H NMR spectrum?
Deuterium (D) ¹H NMR spectrum mein kyun nazar nahi aata?
blocks.explanation: Deuterium ko spin palatne (spin flipping) ke liye ¹H se alag radio frequency chahiye. Yeh ¹H wali frequency absorb nahi karta, is liye ¹H spectrum mein is ki peak nahi aati, yani yeh "ghaib" rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) A compound (C₄H₁₀O) has a ¹H NMR peak area ratio of 1:3:6. How many protons does each signal represent?
C₄H₁₀O ki peak area ratio 1:3:6 hai. Har signal kitne protons ka hai?
blocks.explanation:
Kul H = 10 aur 1 + 3 + 6 = 10, is liye signals 1H, 3H aur 6H ke hain.
(Maslan 2-methoxypropane, (CH₃)₂CH–O–CH₃, par poora utarta hai: 1 CH, 3 OCH₃, 6 do barabar CH₃.)

blocks.prompt:
d) What is the purpose of the D₂O shake test in ¹H NMR?
¹H NMR mein D₂O shake test ka maqsad kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh batata hai ke koi singlet O–H ya N–H proton ka hai ya nahi. D₂O ke saath hilane par yeh protons D se badal jaate hain aur in ki peak ghaib ho jati hai, jis se O–H/N–H signal ki tasdeeq hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
e) List the key features used to interpret a ¹H NMR spectrum.
¹H NMR spectrum samajhne ke ahem nukaat likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Peaks ki tadaad: protons ke environments ki tadaad.
2. Chemical shift (δ): environment ki qism (Table 30.1).
3. Peak area: har environment mein protons ki nisbati tadaad.
4. Splitting (n + 1 rule): saath wale carbons par protons ki tadaad.

blocks.prompt:
f) What does the number of peaks in a ¹³C NMR spectrum represent?
¹³C NMR mein peaks ki tadaad kya batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh molecule mein mukhtalif (non-equivalent) carbon environments ki tadaad hai; barabar carbons aik peak dete hain, maslan propane 2 peaks deta hai.

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar jawab)

blocks.prompt:
a) A -CH₂- group is lying between a -CH₃ and a -CH< group. What is the splitting pattern for the -CH₂- signal? Show your calculation.
-CH₂- group -CH₃ aur -CH< ke darmiyan hai. -CH₂- signal ki splitting kya hogi? Hisaab dikhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Padosi protons: -CH₃ ke 3 aur -CH< ka 1
n = 3 + 1 = 4
Sub-peaks = n + 1 = 4 + 1 = 5
-CH₂- signal quintet (paanch sub-peaks) hoga, maslan CH₃–CH₂–CH< (yeh farz kar ke ke dono padosi barabar splitting karte hain).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Table 30.2 sirf quartet (n = 3) tak hai; n + 1 rule aage bhi chalta hai: n = 4 → 5 sub-peaks (quintet), n = 5 → 6 sub-peaks (sextet).

blocks.prompt:
b) Predict the ¹H NMR spectrum of 1-butanoic acid.
Butanoic acid ka ¹H NMR spectrum predict karein.
blocks.explanation:
Butanoic acid: CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–COOH, chaar proton environments (a, b, c, d) → 4 peaks.
(a) CH₃: alkyl, δ 0.5–1.5 (taqreeban 1.0); 3H; saath CH₂ (n = 2) → triplet.
(b) darmiyani CH₂: alkyl, δ taqreeban 1.5; 2H; padosi CH₃ + CH₂ (n = 5) → 6 sub-peaks (sextet).
(c) C=O ke saath wala CH₂: δ 2.0–2.6 (taqreeban 2.3); 2H; saath CH₂ (n = 2) → triplet.
(d) COOH: δ 9.0–13.0; 1H; O par → singlet.
Peak area ratio CH₃ : CH₂ : CH₂ : COOH = 3 : 2 : 2 : 1.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: “1-butanoic acid” mein '1' faltu hai: carboxyl carbon hamesha C-1 hota hai, is liye naam butanoic acid, CH₃CH₂CH₂COOH, hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) An organic compound has a molecular formula C₂H₅Cl. The ¹H NMR of the compound is given below. Deduce the structure of the compound by using its spectrum. Explain your working in detail.
(Spectrum printed: δ (ppm) from 5 to 0. A quartet (four sub-peaks) centred near 3.6 ppm and a taller triplet (three sub-peaks) centred near 1.3 ppm.)
C₂H₅Cl ka ¹H NMR diya gaya hai. Spectrum se structure nikalein aur tafseel se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Do signals → protons ke do environments.
2. Kul H = 5, yani 2H aur 3H (triplet bari peak hai).
3. 3.6 ppm ke qareeb quartet: δ 3.0–4.5 = electronegative atom ke saath alkyl, yani –CH₂–Cl; n = 4 − 1 = 3 padosi H (aik CH₃).
4. 1.3 ppm ke qareeb triplet: δ 0.5–1.5 = alkyl CH₃; n = 3 − 1 = 2 padosi H (aik CH₂).
5. Mila kar: CH₃–CH₂–Cl, chloroethane. Peak areas CH₂ : CH₃ = 2 : 3 (Example 30.1 jaisa).

blocks.prompt:
d) An organic compound has a formula C₄H₈O. In laboratory, the compound gives 2,4-DNPH and iodoform tests positive but Fehling's test shows a negative result. The ¹H NMR of the compound is shown below. Deduce the structure of the compound and justify your answer.
(Spectrum printed: ppm from 8 to 0. A quartet labelled 2H near 2.5 ppm, a tall singlet labelled 3H near 2.1 ppm and a triplet labelled 3H near 1.0 ppm.)
C₄H₈O: 2,4-DNPH aur iodoform test positive, Fehling's negative; ¹H NMR diya gaya hai. Structure nikalein aur wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Chemical tests:
2,4-DNPH positive → carbonyl (C=O) group.
Fehling's negative → aldehyde nahi, yani ketone.
Iodoform positive → CH₃–CO– group.
¹H NMR (3 signals, 2H + 3H + 3H = 8H):
Singlet, 3H, δ taqreeban 2.1 (2.0–2.6): C=O ke saath CH₃, padosi H nahi → CH₃–CO–.
Quartet, 2H, δ taqreeban 2.5 (2.0–2.6): C=O ke saath CH₂, 3 padosi H → –CO–CH₂–CH₃.
Triplet, 3H, δ taqreeban 1.0 (0.5–1.5): alkyl CH₃, 2 padosi H → –CH₂–CH₃.
Structure: CH₃–CO–CH₂–CH₃, butanone (butan-2-one).

blocks.prompt:
Q4. A chemist suspects a sample contains an O-H group.
a) Describe the "D₂O shake" procedure.
b) What is the expected observation in the ¹H spectrum after the shake?
c) Write the equilibrium equation for the exchange and explain why it causes this observation.
Sample mein O-H ka shak hai. a) D₂O shake ka tareeqa; b) shake ke baad ¹H spectrum mein kya nazar aayega; c) exchange ki equilibrium equation aur wajah.
blocks.explanation:
a) Tareeqa:
1. Compound ka ¹H NMR spectrum record karein; is mein O–H proton samet tamam H nazar aate hain (O–H singlet ka δ bohat badalta hai, is liye pehchanna mushkil).
2. NMR sample tube mein D₂O ke chand qatre dal kar achhi tarah hilayein.
3. Spectrum dobara record karein aur dono ka muqabla karein.
b) Mushahida: doosre spectrum mein O–H proton wala singlet ghaib ho jata hai; C–H wale signals waise hi rehte hain. Is se tasdeeq hoti hai ke peak O–H ki thi (N–H ke liye bhi yahi).
c) Equilibrium:
R–O–H + D₂O ⇌ R–O–D + HOD
Bohat electronegative O se jura H aasani aur tezi se D₂O ke D se badal jata hai. Deuterium ko spin flipping ke liye ¹H se alag energy (radio frequency) chahiye, is liye O–D group ¹H spectrum mein peak nahi deta, yani "ghaib" ho jata hai. C–H wale hydrogens nahi badalte, is liye un ki peaks rehti hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 Predict the number of ¹³C NMR peaks for the following two isomers:
a) Pentane
b) 2,2-dimethylpropane
Justify each answer by identifying the sets of equivalent carbons.
Pentane aur 2,2-dimethylpropane ki ¹³C NMR peaks ki tadaad batayein aur barabar carbons ke sets pehchan kar wajah dein.
blocks.explanation:
a) Pentane, CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ (C₅H₁₂): molecule C-3 ke gird symmetrical (dono taraf aik jaisa) hai.
Set 1: C-1 aur C-5 (dono kinaron ke CH₃), barabar
Set 2: C-2 aur C-4 (CH₃ ke saath wale CH₂), barabar
Set 3: C-3 (darmiyani CH₂)
→ 3 peaks (sab alkyl range 0–50 ppm mein).
b) 2,2-Dimethylpropane, C(CH₃)₄ (C₅H₁₂):
Set 1: chaaron CH₃ carbons, sab aik hi markazi carbon se jure, barabar
Set 2: markazi quaternary carbon
→ 2 peaks.
Dono C₅H₁₂ ke isomers hain magar carbon environments mukhtalif hone se peaks ki tadaad mukhtalif hai; is liye ¹³C NMR in mein farq kar deta hai.
